mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at 71 degrees with overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School under a Waning Gibbous moon.

September is Hunger Action Month in Verona. Mayor Luke Diaz is encouraging residents to help tackle food insecurity, an issue affecting 1 in 8 people in Southwest Wisconsin, by volunteering or donating.

There is plenty to do with Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today, followed by a busy tomorrow featuring trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music and the downtown Farmer's Market.
On August 19, there was a motor vehicle crash on North Main Street at Bering Drive where drivers were cited for license and right of way violations.
The Culver's of Verona location is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:30 AM.
